what: Below the company tab row, one quote moves to the next every 8 seconds. The outgoing quote goes up 10px with 5px blur and disappears in .48s, the incoming quote starts 10px below with 5px blur and becomes crisp in .8s, and the name line rises 6px, .1s late. A white pill marker slides behind the chosen tab in .5s and the other tabs fade to .35. Clicking a tab goes there and restarts the 8s count. It pauses when offscreen

options.dur: Text blur and shift duration (sec), default .8

note: The tab row is set to position:relative, and the pill’s background and shadow are painted by the user. The first child of the quote box is the fading text and by is the name line

from.where: index.html [data-slot=testimonial-tabs] three company tabs and a quote
